user.title: Connect your Rabot contract
user.description: Enter your contract number and an access token. Create a token in the Rabot app under Services > Home Assistant Integration. It is shown only once, right after you create it.

data_description.contract_number: The contract number shown in the Rabot app under Services > Home Assistant Integration.
data_description.api_token: The token from the Rabot app. It is valid for one year and works only for this contract.

advanced.name: Advanced settings
advanced.description: Only change the server address for test environments.

data_description.host: Server address including the scheme (http or https) and, if needed, the port.

reauth_confirm.title: Rabot token needs renewal
reauth_confirm.description: The token for contract {contract_number} was rejected, has expired or was deleted, or none is stored yet. Create a new token in the Rabot app under Services > Home Assistant Integration and paste it here.

data_description.api_token: A new token from the Rabot app. It is shown only once, right after you create it.

reconfigure.title: Change the Rabot server
reconfigure.description: Change the server address for contract {contract_number}. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: Server address including the scheme (http or https) and, if needed, the port.
data_description.api_token: A new token from the Rabot app. Leave empty to keep the stored token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check your network connection and, if you changed it, the server address.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. It may have expired or been deleted, or belong to another contract. Create a new token in the Rabot app.
error.contract_not_found: The server did not find this contract. Check the contract number and the server address.
error.invalid_host: Enter a full address that starts with the scheme (http or https).
error.invalid_token: This is not a valid token. Copy the complete token from the Rabot app.
error.service_unavailable: Rabot prices are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This contract is already set up.
